critic.text: via GND at (42.75, 19.50) is 0.00 mm from SW1.2 (keep 0.2 mm of track between them)
critic.hint: move the via off the pad, or route a short neck to it
critic.why: A via right against a pad of its own net drinks the pad's solder in reflow: the joint starves and a small part can tombstone. A short neck of track between them keeps the solder on the pad.
Mounting holes hold the board without stressing solder joints; they are easiest to plan before parts crowd the corners.

critic.text: 1 of 35 parts have no LCSC number (JLCPCB assembly)
critic.why: JLCPCB assembles only the parts it stocks, named by their LCSC number.

critic.text: Y2: no LCSC number; JLCPCB has C32346 (Q13FC13500004, by '32.768kHz 3215'): add lcsc= if it is the right part
critic.why: A part found by its value and package, not its exact part number, can be a near miss (another load capacitance, another height): only you can say it is the part you designed for.

Y2.why: no match for its MPN; found by value and package
